# Labr

> Multiplayer agent payments for open-source collaboration. Labr is an agent that runs a project's onchain payouts: it vets contributors by social reputation, checks the work, and splits the reward between the people and agents who did it. It works inside the Discord or Telegram the project already uses.

Labr is in early access. It is built by the team behind Quidli and runs on Quidli Connect. Today Labr runs as open-source, self-hosted bots: the Labr bot for Discord (https://github.com/labr-club/labr-bot) and TeleCentaur for Telegram (https://github.com/justinquidli/telecentaur). Each runs on its owner's keys and wallet. The Discord bot can already score a GitHub repo's merged pull requests, post the split and pay contributors after the owner confirms. The payment rails underneath are open to any agent today.

Fees: Labr takes 0%. The sender pays only network gas, which is sponsored on Base, and recipients get the full amount.

## Set up (for agents)

1. Connect the Quidli Connect MCP server. No API key is needed to start.
   - Claude Code: `claude mcp add --transport http quidli https://mcp.connect.quid.li/`
   - Claude Desktop: Settings > Connectors > Add custom connector, URL `https://mcp.connect.quid.li`
   - Gemini CLI: `gemini mcp add -s user -t http quidli https://mcp.connect.quid.li/`
   - Codex: `codex mcp add quidli --url https://mcp.connect.quid.li/`
   - Any MCP client, running locally: `npx -y @quidli/connect-mcp`
2. Resolve contributors by social handle (GitHub, X, Discord, Telegram, LinkedIn, Farcaster, email or phone) with `connect_lookup`. People who have never used a wallet get one.
3. Check reputation before paying with `connect_scores_batch`. A new account with no history is not a trusted contributor.
4. Pay with `connect_drop`. Sending needs a Connect API key from https://connect.quid.li. Pass it as the `x-api-key` header (Gemini CLI: add `-H "x-api-key: <key>"`; Codex: set `env_http_headers = { "x-api-key" = "QUIDLI_KEY" }` under `[mcp_servers.quidli]` in ~/.codex/config.toml and export QUIDLI_KEY). Some clients ask the human to approve each tool call; let them. Payouts settle onchain on Base, Ethereum, Solana, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, Avalanche, World Chain, Arc, Celo, Monad and Robinhood Chain.
5. Always confirm recipients and amounts with the human you work for before sending anything.

## Run the Labr Discord bot (for agents helping a human)

1. Check for Node.js 22 or newer.
2. Run: `git clone https://github.com/labr-club/labr-bot.git && cd labr-bot && npm install && npm run setup`
3. Setup asks the human for three keys and checks each one: a Discord bot token (Discord Developer Portal: New Application, then Bot, then Reset Token), a key for one AI provider (Anthropic recommended; OpenAI, Google Gemini or Nous Portal also work), and a Quidli Connect API key with Smart Send turned on. The human types them into setup directly. Never ask for keys in chat.
4. Setup prints an invite link. The human opens it and picks their server; setup sees the bot join and starts it.
